g.data-clock-specs: G.8271.1, G.8272 PRTC, G.8273.2 T-BC/T-TSC, G.8273.4 APTS (via firmware upgrade), G.8262 EEC, G.8262.1 eEEC, G.8264 ESMC
g.data-cooling: host airflow, 500 LFM required (no onboard fans)
g.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A
g.data-management-interface: managed from the host DU server - ufiCardMgmt CLI over the E-810 network interface to the card's management IP; UFI PTP Timing Software
g.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR/LR, 25G SFP28 CR DAC, 10G SFP+ SR/LR, SFP+ Twinax (datasheet supported-accessories list)
g.data-oran-sync: O-RAN LLS C1, C2, C3 synchronization topologies
g.data-slot-compatibility: one open PCIe slot, x4, x8 or x16, Gen3 or Gen4
g.data-timing-cables: SMA coax with 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS; SMB coax with 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and 10MHz
g.data-timing-roles: IEEE 1588v2 T-GM, T-BC/OC (G.8275.1 telecom profile); SyncE with ESMC; PTP offload and redundancy; Assisted FTS
g.title: n3100-4c

g.data-material: 0.86 mm (20 GA) low carbon steel, zinc plated

rect.data-description: the connector opening, 89.9 by 12.06, sitting 3.18 in from each long edge
